narrative.details:
<Dorius groans.>

I'm badly injured, friend. Feel... light headed... World spinning... Bleeding... internally.

I must get back to Ironforge. Help me, adventurer.
narrative.objectives: Help Dorius get back to Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: This letter was dropped by Dorius when he was shot.
narrative.requestItemsText: I'm not going to make it...

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 48 to 55, 27,150 XP in all.

quests.name: Suntara Stones
quests.objectiveText: Help Dorius get back to Ironforge.

quests.name: Suntara Stones
quests.objectiveText: Take the Singed Letter to Thorius in Ironforge.

quests.name: Dwarven Justice
quests.objectiveText: Return to the Searing Gorge and find Dorius's archaeology unit.

quests.name: Release Them
quests.objectiveText: Find the Mysterious Artifact being guarded by the Twilight's Hammer Idolaters in the northwest quadrant of the Searing Gorge and bring it to the Altar of Suntara in the Slag Pit.

quests.name: Rise, Obsidion!
quests.objectiveText: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.
